593cb71200.q: What is the foundational approach to conducting human capital research across different company sizes and industries?
593cb71200.a: The research focuses on providing actionable solutions to problems specific to your industry, location, and company size rather than generic best practices. As Bersin explains, studying how Google or Walmart manages performance may not apply to a fast-growing tech company or small retailer. The goal is to provide relevant case studies and examples from companies similar to yours so the insights are directly applicable to your situation.

3c4ad64ac0.q: How has the business model for monetizing human capital research evolved over the past decade?
3c4ad64ac0.a: The Josh Bersin Company initially used a research membership model similar to Gartner, selling access to a library of reports, models, and frameworks. Over the last decade, this evolved into videos, podcasts, and educational materials because consumers need content relevant to their specific job, not everything in management and HR. The business now includes subscription models that deliver appropriate research to different roles—from C-level executives to recruiters, L&D specialists, and technology vendors.

114a5b08d6.q: What opportunity did the emergence of large language models like ChatGPT create for HR research organizations?

This led to the creation of Galileo, initially called the co-pilot, which not only found information but could generate new content—building implementation plans, RFP checklists, hiring guides, and behavioral interview guides using the organization's intellectual property.

478f65918c.q: Why did the strategy shift from building a specialized AI agent to creating a portable intelligence layer across multiple platforms?
478f65918c.a: Customers indicated they already had AI platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot and wanted Galileo integrated there rather than as a separate tool. This led to deals with ServiceNow, SAP, Workday, and others. The shift revealed that Galileo's power was being constrained by individual platforms, and the real value came from interleaving Galileo's intelligence with company policies and human capital data.
478f65918c.e: Introducing The Jupiter Release of Galileo: An Inside Story

dd815a00dd.q: What structural changes were made to optimize research content for AI consumption, and what is the Agent Ready Corpus?
dd815a00dd.a: The Josh Bersin Company realized their content, written like traditional books with introductions, tables of contents, and conclusions, was inefficient for AI. They built ARC (Agent Ready Corpus), a new architecture that extracts the essence of Galileo's data, chunks it into machine-readable form, and carefully indexes it with eight dimensions of tagging so LLMs can read it accurately without hallucinating or guessing. This approach eliminates unnecessary boilerplate and enables the AI to cite sources precisely.
dd815a00dd.e: Introducing The Jupiter Release of Galileo: An Inside Story

299b566b0b.q: What performance advantage does the optimized Agent Ready Corpus deliver compared to general-purpose language models?
299b566b0b.a: The ARC corpus is 10 to 100 times more efficient at token usage for running complex HR questions compared to using ChatGPT or Claude alone. Benchmarking against 30 golden prompts—complex human capital questions—showed that general LLMs hallucinate and misattribute information, while the optimized corpus is fast, secure, reliable, predictable, truthful, and efficient, providing accurate answers by industry, company size, domain, and problem.
299b566b0b.e: Introducing The Jupiter Release of Galileo: An Inside Story

0356b7d47c.q: How does the Jupiter release integrate human capital intelligence with enterprise systems and business problem-solving?
0356b7d47c.a: Galileo Jupiter includes a layer that understands data models from SAP, Oracle, Workday, and HiBob, allowing users to ask questions that combine Galileo's intelligence with company-specific human capital data. It can answer questions like 'What is the span of control of our sales department?' and compare salaries to benchmarks. The system creates a chain of thought connecting business problems to human capital issues and solutions, embedded in the HR 2030 model.
0356b7d47c.e: Introducing The Jupiter Release of Galileo: An Inside Story

5bfaf1ea77.q: What new data sources and benchmarks were added to Galileo to enhance its relevance for enterprise decision-making?
5bfaf1ea77.a: The Jupiter release added executive compensation data from Equilar, job titles and skills for every major position in every functional area, salary benchmarks from Wagescape and other sources covering approximately 120 countries, benchmarks on turnover, business practices, and hundreds of datasets on vendor market technologies and HR solutions. This creates a comprehensive intelligence layer for salary analysis, skills assessment, and vendor evaluation.
5bfaf1ea77.e: Introducing The Jupiter Release of Galileo: An Inside Story

Users can ask the Copilot implementation of Galileo to analyze their emails over two years and identify top skills relative to a new project, then recommend learning paths. Clients have built personal management coaches that read prior week meetings, apply their own management rubric, and provide coaching on performance improvements, with Galileo informing these insights.

It transforms the 30 years of research, printing, layout, and design into a format perfectly readable by machines, enabling the AI to make completely accurate and detailed analysis. It shifts the business from publishing PDF reports to producing content in Agent Ready Corpus form available within hours, dramatically accelerating the delivery of human capital intelligence.
